texts.name: Thor
texts.biography: God of thunder and the mightiest warrior of Asgard. Wherever Mjolnir falls, giants go down.

specialty.name: Thor's Hammer
specialty.description:
At the start of each round the hammer strikes the enemy stack with the most health for 30 + hero level × 10 air spell damage.

{Affinity}: god powers under Thor are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Forseti
texts.biography: God of justice and reconciliation; every quarrel is settled in his hall. Even trolls heed his judgement.

specialty.name: Favor: Troll
specialty.description:
Favor +1 each round (+1 more after acting); at each threshold a boon:
{2 pts}: Northern Trolls gain Divinity for 2 rounds.
{4 pts}: Healing Spring: Northern Trolls heal to full health.
{7 pts}: Thunder Dread: all enemies Defense -4 for 2 rounds.

{Affinity}: god powers under Thor are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Skadi
texts.biography: Huntress of the snowfields who chases her prey on skis; her arrows never miss.

specialty.name: Archery
specialty.description:
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Archery skill percentage.

{Affinity}: god powers under Thor are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Tyr
texts.biography: The one-handed god of war, who gave his right hand to bind the wolf Fenrir. Wolves know his scent.

specialty.name: Favor: Winter Wolf
specialty.description:
Favor +1 each round (+1 more after acting); at each threshold a boon:
{2 pts}: Fimbulwinter Wolves gain Divinity for 2 rounds.
{4 pts}: War God's Valor: Fimbulwinter Wolves Attack +6 for 2 rounds.
{7 pts}: Thunder Dread: all enemies Defense -4 for 2 rounds.

{Affinity}: god powers under Thor are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Sif
texts.biography: Thor's wife, whose golden hair the dwarves spun from real gold. Those she guards do not fall easily.

specialty.name: Armorer
specialty.description:
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Armorer skill percentage.

{Affinity}: god powers under Thor are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Thjalfi
texts.biography: Thor's servant, the fastest mortal among the gods, who once raced thought itself.

specialty.name: Logistics
specialty.description:
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Logistics skill percentage.

{Affinity}: god powers under Thor are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Brokk
texts.biography: A dwarven smith who, with his brother Eitri, forged the hammer Mjolnir.

specialty.name: Norse Ballista
specialty.description:
Increases the Attack and Defense of the Norse Ballista by 20% for every 5 levels.

{Affinity}: god powers under Thor are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Odin
texts.biography: The All-Father, who traded an eye for wisdom. Two ravens bring him the world's news each day, and the warriors of Valhalla await only his call.

specialty.name: Call of the Einherjar
specialty.description:
Valhalla gathers Einherjar faster: + hero level × 2% (up to +50%); the first recall of Einherjar each battle brings one more stack.

{Affinity}: god powers under Odin are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Freyja
texts.biography: Goddess of love and war, who shares the fallen of the battlefield with Odin. The valkyries are her messengers.

specialty.name: Favor: Valkyrie
specialty.description:
Favor +1 each round (+1 more after acting); at each threshold a boon:
{2 pts}: Asgard Valkyries gain Divinity for 2 rounds.
{4 pts}: Goddess's Tears: all living troops heal 20% health.
{7 pts}: Raven Omen: whole army morale +1 and Attack +2 for 2 rounds.

{Affinity}: god powers under Odin are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Njord
texts.biography: God of sea winds and sailing; sailors pray to him for calm seas before they set out.

specialty.name: Navigation
specialty.description:
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Navigation skill percentage.

{Affinity}: god powers under Odin are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Baldr
texts.biography: God of light; all things once swore never to harm him. Wherever his light falls, blades cut keener.

specialty.name: Bless Master

texts.name: Frigg
texts.biography: Odin's wife, who foresees every fate yet never speaks of it.

specialty.name: Mysticism
specialty.description:
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Mysticism skill percentage.

{Affinity}: god powers under Odin are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Mimir
texts.biography: Keeper of the well of wisdom. His head still counsels Odin beside the well.

specialty.name: Learning
specialty.description:
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Learning skill percentage.

{Affinity}: god powers under Odin are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Reginleif
texts.biography: A valkyrie Odin sent to the world of men, fighting beside mortal heroes on the eve of Ragnarok.

specialty.name: Haste Master
specialty.description:
Haste raises the target's Speed further:
level 1-2 +3, level 3-4 +2, level 5-6 +1.

{Affinity}: god powers under Odin are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Loki
texts.biography: God of trickery, who can take any shape. His enemies cannot tell which foe is real.

specialty.name: Trickster's Illusion
specialty.description:
At the start of battle, the enemy stack with the most health (except level 7) is copied as an illusion that fights for you: 10% of its size + 1% per level (up to 35%).

{Affinity}: god powers under Loki are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Heimdall
texts.biography: Watchman of the rainbow bridge, who can hear the grass grow. When Ragnarok comes he will sound his horn.

specialty.name: Scouting
specialty.tooltip: Special: scouting radius grows with level
specialty.description:
Scouting radius grows with level: +1 at level 2, +2 at 8, +3 at 14, then about +1 every 6-7 levels.

{Affinity}: god powers under Loki are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Bragi
texts.biography: God of poetry, with runes carved on his tongue. His war songs make the most timid man charge.

specialty.name: Bloodlust Master
specialty.description:
Bloodlust raises the target's Attack further:
level 1-2 +3, level 3-4 +2, level 5-6 +1.

{Affinity}: god powers under Loki are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Hel
texts.biography: Loki's daughter, queen of the dead, half living and half rotting. The frost giants obey her.

specialty.name: Favor: Titan
specialty.description:
Favor +1 each round (+1 more after acting); at each threshold a boon:
{2 pts}: Tundra Titans gain Divinity for 2 rounds.
{4 pts}: Queen of the Dead: Tundra Titans deal +25% damage for 2 rounds.
{7 pts}: Trickery: all enemies Attack -3 for 2 rounds.

{Affinity}: god powers under Loki are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Sigyn
texts.biography: Loki's wife, who holds a bowl over him to catch the venom while he is punished, and never leaves.

specialty.name: First Aid
specialty.description:
Receives a 5% per level bonus to First Aid skill percentage.

{Affinity}: god powers under Loki are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Angrboda
texts.biography: Giantess of the Iron Wood, mother of Fenrir, Jormungandr and Hel. The monsters of the deep are all her brood.

specialty.name: Favor: Kraken
specialty.description:
Favor +1 each round (+1 more after acting); at each threshold a boon:
{2 pts}: Krakens gain Divinity for 2 rounds.
{4 pts}: Mother's Shelter: Krakens take 50% less damage this round.
{7 pts}: Trickery: all enemies Attack -3 for 2 rounds.

{Affinity}: god powers under Loki are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Skult
texts.biography: A traitor posing as a Norse envoy, sowing discord on behalf of the underworld.

specialty.name: Intelligence
specialty.description:
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Intelligence skill percentage.

{Affinity}: god powers under Loki are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Freyr
texts.biography: God of fertility, sun and rain, who rides the golden boar Gullinbursti. Wherever he goes, the harvest is rich.

specialty.name: Gullinbursti
specialty.description:
At the start of battle Gullinbursti joins in: 1 + hero level ÷ 8 of them; they leave when the battle ends.

{Affinity}: god powers under Freyr are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Ullr
texts.biography: God of archery and the hunt, who lives in Yew Dale. Thrown blades fly as true as arrows in his eyes.

specialty.name: Favor: Axeman
specialty.description:
Favor +1 each round (+1 more after acting); at each threshold a boon:
{2 pts}: Throwing Axemen gain Divinity for 2 rounds.
{4 pts}: Hunter's Eye: Throwing Axemen ranged damage +30% for 2 rounds.
{7 pts}: Plenty: all living troops heal 30% health.

{Affinity}: god powers under Freyr are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Aegir
texts.biography: King of the sea giants. The gods linger at his feasts, and the treasures of the deep never run dry.

specialty.name: +350 Gold
specialty.description:
The kingdom receives an additional 350 gold per day.

{Affinity}: god powers under Freyr are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Vidar
texts.biography: The silent god of vengeance, fated to avenge his father Odin at Ragnarok. Dragon fire serves him.

specialty.name: Favor: Fafnir
specialty.description:
Favor +1 each round (+1 more after acting); at each threshold a boon:
{2 pts}: Fafnirs gain Divinity for 2 rounds.
{4 pts}: Silent Vengeance: Fafnirs Attack and Defense +4 for 2 rounds.
{7 pts}: Plenty: all living troops heal 30% health.

{Affinity}: god powers under Freyr are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Gerd
texts.biography: Freyr's wife, a beautiful giantess. To win her, Freyr gave away his sword.

specialty.name: Estates
specialty.description:
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Estates skill percentage.

{Affinity}: god powers under Freyr are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Skirnir
texts.biography: Freyr's messenger, who went to the land of the giants to woo a bride for his master; his tongue is worth a thousand swords.

specialty.name: Diplomacy
specialty.description:
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Diplomacy skill percentage.

{Affinity}: god powers under Freyr are stronger; see each spell.

texts.name: Sigurd
texts.biography: The dragon slayer who killed Fafnir with the sword Gram; after tasting the dragon's blood he understood the speech of birds.

specialty.name: Favor: Berserker
specialty.description:
Favor +1 each round (+1 more after acting); at each threshold a boon:
{2 pts}: Viking Berserkers gain Divinity for 2 rounds.
{4 pts}: Dragon-Slayer's Valor: Viking Berserkers attack one more time this round.
{7 pts}: Plenty: all living troops heal 30% health.

{Affinity}: god powers under Freyr are stronger; see each spell.
